response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT IFNULL(k_symbol, '') AS k_symbol, amount FROM `order` WHERE amount > 2802), purpose_avg AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM filtered GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM purpose_avg) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM purpose_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY p.avg_amount DESC;
